contamination: Known contamination: PubMedQA contexts are PubMed abstracts that PubMed-trained readers may have seen with their conclusions; Duan trained on 445 PQA-L items that may overlap the official test list, and on a random 20,000-encounter UCI sample that may overlap our test split. Both favor Duan.
